observations: A pink field holds two large spiral forms side by side near the top center: the left ringed in yellow and black, the right in dark red with crossing lines over it.
A vertical column of rounded black-outlined squares with orange-brown fills runs down the right edge, evenly spaced from top to bottom.
In the lower center, a coral-red open-jawed form with radiating lines sits above a zigzag band, flanked by black-and-yellow diagonal stripes.
reading: Two spiral forms anchor the upper half — one warm yellow, one deep red — each pulling the eye inward before zigzag bands and loose overhead lines push it back out. The right-edge column of squares holds the composition steady against that noise. Below, the open-jawed shape reads as raw appetite or alarm. The pink field keeps the whole from tipping into dread.
